title: verify_sig maps RSA/ECDSA failure to SmimeError::Other not SignatureVerification
description: verify.rs line 321: verify_sig passes 'let e = |msg: String| SmimeError::Other(msg)' as the error constructor. So when an RSA or ECDSA signature fails in sig_verify, the error is SmimeError::Other, not SmimeError::SignatureVerification. Compare: cert.rs verify_signature line 253 maps cert-chain sig errors to CertChain, which is correct for that context. But verify.rs line 321 mapping to Other means that a signature failure in step 4 of verify_one arrives as Other('RSA sig verify: ...'), not SignatureVerification. The public API contract implied by the variant name is broken: SignatureVerification exists precisely for this case, but it is not used here.
close_reason: P4 opinion: verify_sig maps sig failures to Other; acceptable until a specific caller use-case requires finer discrimination.
